title: Tyrant Abuses Me? Turn Around and Collude with the Eunuch to Seize His Empire
author: Qing Shan You Ci
synopsis:
Xiang Jun entered the palace eight years ago, striving relentlessly, currying favor everywhere, yet she was still ground down, used, humiliated, and abandoned by the noble masters of the palace...
The nobles lounged in luxury atop piles of bones, mocking her desperate efforts and ignorance of her place.
In the end, the children she had fought to bear called another woman "Mother," and she was vivisected to take the child from her womb, dying with her eyes wide open in resentment.
After her death, only that cold and distant eunuch, whom she had met but a few times, gave her a proper burial, granting her the last shred of dignity.
Upon reawakening, Xiang Jun realized she was nothing more than a cannon fodder female antagonist in a story.
In this life, Xiang Jun would carve a different path for herself.
If those noble masters refused to treat them—those of lowly birth—as human, then she would conspire with the equally lowly eunuch, stirring up storms and turning the world upside down.
"Tingxue, in this life, let us be a pair of power-hungry, scheming villains—a treacherous eunuch and a bewitching concubine."
